text: The facade cladding detail was revised after the architect's comment. Anna Keller will update the facade shop drawings by 2026-09-20. This affects the Facade discipline.

The HVAC layout was changed because of a new ceiling requirement. Electrical must review the cable routing based on the new HVAC layout. Updated drawings are required before 2026-09-15. No responsible person has currently been assigned for the electrical review. Construction Package EL-04 depends on this clarification.

It was decided to reroute the plumbing risers on level 3 because the structural beam position changed. Maria Novak will update the structural drawings. No deadline has been agreed yet for this update.
Julia Wenzel was assigned to revise the fire safety concept by 2026-08-20 after the escape route layout changed. The revised concept is still outstanding.
The plumbing riser diagram PL-03 cannot be finalized until the new structural beam position is confirmed. Structural still needs to confirm the beam position.
Peter Braun will update drawing package MEP-99 by 2026-09-30 following the coordination clash review.
The ceiling height was reduced in the east wing, affecting both HVAC and Electrical. Peter Braun will issue the revised HVAC layout by 2026-09-12.
The escape route change may require re-checking the structural openings in ST-01, which has not been confirmed by anyone.
